QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Spring Flower Festival
QuestInfo.0: Spring blooms in Maple World. You hear that Cassandra is holding charge a Spring Flower Festival. Let's go talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Let's go ahead and help out Cassandra on her request.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Cassandra plant the spring flowers and bring them to full bloom, and you received one in return. Apparently this will be enough to stimulate the various research taking place in Maple World regarding these spring flowers.
QuestInfo.summary: Let's give Cassanda 10 Spring Flower Seeds and 10 Dazzling Sunlight.

0.0: Can you hear that spring is coming?

yes.0: I love warm weather! Please collect 10 Spring Flower Seeds around Maple World. I want to plant an azalea, a forsythia, and a clover that bloom in the spring.
yes.1: Every flower has its own floral language. Isn't that sweet? I can let you know your flower's language once you give it to me. So please bring #b10 Spring Flower Seeds and 10 Dazzling Sunlights#k to plant a spring flower!

no.0: Don't you know that spring is coming to Maple World?

1.0: Wow! You finally collected all of the seeds! Thank you. We can plant spring flowers.

yes.0: The flower finally blooms! The azalea's floral language is 'love', the forsythia's is 'hope', and the clover's is 'luck'! I will give a magic buff like your flower!

item.0: Not enough! I told you that you have to collect #b10 Spring Flower Seeds and 10 Dazzling Sunlights#k.
